reasons.C: Long, balanced sentences joined by semicolons and qualifying clauses, tentative hedges ('I suspect', 'it seems to me', 'perhaps') and a reflective aphoristic close closely match the passage's measured movement; its hedging runs slightly thick but not to caricature.
reasons.A: Right stance and register with similar hedges and a rhetorical question, but it breaks the rhythm with clipped sentences and an 'And that, I think' opener, which makes it punchier and more conversational than the passage.
reasons.B: Short declarative sentences, almost no hedging and an assertive, advisory tone ('Organisations have to...'), so it reads as a different, plainer writer.
